name: Bayan / bahasa Bayan
confidence_why: The only description of Bayan (Dusun Malang) stress, Admojo, Kalamper and Mulyani 1994, marks four impressionistic stress grades on its example words but concludes that no distinctive stress was found, and the other works read (Nanang, Usman and Kalamper 1988; Andriastuti and Kalamper 1991; Hudson 1967; Smith 2017) say nothing about stress, so the record's refusal to state a placement rests on a single first-hand source with nothing against it.
catalog_citation: Admojo, Wihadi; Yohannes Kalamper; Dewi Mulyani. 1994. Fonologi Bahasa Bayan. Jakarta: Pusat Pembinaan dan Pengembangan Bahasa, Departemen Pendidikan dan Kebudayaan. xiv+130 pp. ISBN 979-459-430-X (Badan Bahasa repository eprint 1810).
catalog_locator: Sec. 2.8 'Unsur Suprasegmental' and 2.8.1 'Ciri Tekanan', pp.116-117 (read as 200-dpi); conclusion p.129, Acrobat scan).
catalog_quote: 2.8.1. Ciri Tekanan. Ciri tekanan ini dibedakan atas empat macam dengan kriteria sebagai berikut: tekanan keras dengan tanda [´], tekanan agak keras dengan tanda [ˆ], tekanan sedang dengan tanda [ˋ], tekanan lemah dengan tanda [ˇ]. a. Tekanan Kata Bersuku Satu. Kata yang bersuku satu pada umumnya mendapat tekanan keras, misalnya seperti pada contoh berikut ini. ... b. Tekanan kata Bersuku Dua. Kata bersuku dua umumnya bertekanan sedanga [sic] dan agak keras, misalnya seperti pada contoh ini. (121) [àlî] 'gali' [èmpâ] 'ikan gabus' [sùbÛr] 'subur' [pìntâr] 'pandai' [dànâw] 'danau' [raŋkay] 'kerangka'. c. Tekanan Kata Bersuku Tiga. Kata bersuku tiga umumnya bertekanan sedang, agak keras, dan agak lemah, seperti pada contoh berikut ini. (122) ... [nàrɔ̂mbɔ̂n] 'mencucur' [bàlaŋûy] 'berenang' [màhâhaŋ] 'sakit' [làkâwâŋ] 'pingang' [sàlâwâr] 'celana'. d. Tekanan Kata Bersuku Empat. Kata bersuku empat umumnya bertekanan, seperti pada contoh berikut ini. (123) [pùlaùkâyû] 'hutan' [kàlàbâmbâŋ] 'kupu-kupu' [kàlàbîmbiŋ] 'belimbing' [pùyàkâlâ] 'kalajengking' [tàràsâkûy] 'terantuk'. Berdasarkan data yang diperoleh, belum ditemukan tekanan yang distintif dalam bahasa Bayan. [p.129] Berdasarkan data yang telah dihimpun, tidak ditemukan unsur suprasegmental yang distingtif walaupun dalam bahasa Bayan terdapat ciri nada, tekanan, sendi, dan durasi.

new_statements.translation: Monosyllabic words generally receive strong stress ... b. Stress in disyllabic words. Disyllabic words generally carry medium and fairly-strong stress [grave = medium on the first syllable, circumflex = fairly strong on the second], e.g. (121) [àlî] 'dig', [èmpâ] 'snakehead fish', [sùbÛr] 'fertile', [pìntâr] 'clever', [dànâw] 'lake' ... c. Stress in trisyllabic words. Trisyllabic words generally carry medium, fairly-strong and fairly-weak stress ... [bàlaŋûy] 'swim', [màhâhaŋ] 'ill', [làkâwâŋ] 'waist' ... d. Four-syllable words are generally stressed as in (123) [pùlaùkâyû] 'forest', [kàlàbambâŋ] 'butterfly' ... On the data obtained, no distinctive stress has been found in Bayan.

new_statements.second_reader_evidence: File checked: (146 pp., Acrobat scanned layer; cover 'Fonologi Bahasa Bayan, Departemen Pendidikan dan Kebudayaan 1994'). I rendered pp.131-132 (printed 116-117) at 150/300 dpi and p.144 (printed 129) and read them directly. QUOTE: every stitched piece of the reported quote is on printed pp.116-117 verbatim, including the misprint 'sedanga'; the only deviation is that the quote runs 'd. Kata bersuku empat umumnya bertekanan..' whereas the print has the sub-heading 'd.Tekanan Kata Bersuku Empat' before that sentence (heading elided without an ellipsis). The closing sentence 'Berdasarkan data yang diperoleh, belum ditemukan tekanan yang distintif dalam bahasa Bayan.' is on p.117, and p.129 re…
new_statements.rule_in_words: Stress is described as non-contrastive ('not distinctive'). The authors grade syllables on four impressionistic levels; in polysyllables prominence rises toward the right edge: disyllables are marked medium+fairly-strong (final syllable strongest); for trisyllables the prose order (medium, fairly strong, fairly weak) implies the penult is strongest, but the transcribed examples put the 'fairly strong' circumflex on the penult, the final, or both; four-syllable words are marked weak-weak then circumflex on the last one or two syllables. No single fixed position is stated, and the disyllabic (final) and trisyllabic-prose (penult) patterns disagree.
new_statements.secondary_stress: No explicit secondary-stress statement; the four-level marking gives 'sedang' (medium) to initial syllables of polysyllables and sometimes marks both of the last two syllables 'agak keras'.
new_statements.exceptions: None stated; [raŋkay] 'kerangka' in (121) is printed without marks. Conclusion (p.129): 'tidak ditemukan unsur suprasegmental yang distingtif walaupun dalam bahasa Bayan terdapat ciri nada, tekanan, sendi, dan durasi.'
new_statements.domain_note: Isolated words (citation forms) elicited from speakers in Butong / Bintang Ninggi, Kec. Teweh Tengah; section 2.8 explicitly limits the suprasegmental analysis to the word ('hanya terbatas pada konstruksi kata'). Impressionistic, no instrumental data.
new_statements.identity_note: All three Badan Bahasa books describe 'bahasa Bayan' (Dusun Bayan), spoken in Desa Butong and Bintang Ninggi I/II, Kec. Teweh Tengah, Kab. Barito Utara, Kalimantan Tengah. Glottolog 5.1 files them under Dusun Malang [duq] dusu1269 and has a dialect node Bayan = baya1259 (sister to Nuclear Dusun Malang nucl1554). The authors note Riwut (1979) lists Dusun Bayan and Dusun Malang as separate Dusun subgroups while Hudson (1967) does not list Bayan at all. No description of nuclear Dusun Malang stress was found.
